thesis.title: Bachelor's Thesis
thesis.description: Carbon Footprint Calculator for Product Structure Data — Grade: 4/5

content.summary: Designed and implemented a Python-based carbon footprint calculator at Genelec OY that calculates CO₂e emissions for individual products using real production data. Based on simplified Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) methodology.

projects.name: Carbon Footprint Calculator
projects.description: Software tool that calculates CO₂ equivalent emissions per product by analyzing materials, energy consumption, transport distances, and packaging. Users can modify inputs (material choices, transport distances) and see real-time impact on product emissions. Built for Genelec's sustainability planning.

content.learning_notes: This project taught me to work with cross-functional teams (production, design, sustainability experts) and translate complex environmental data into actionable software.
